label: Direct outside air – evaporative + chiller assist
description: Outside air enters the server room; evaporative pre-cooling may run together with the chiller (hybrid).
source: A, dew_max, dew_min: ASHRAE TC 9.9 recommended envelope; eps_evap: ASHRAE Handbook HVAC Systems and Equipment ch. 41 (rigid media 70-95 %)

label: Indirect (heat exchanger) – evaporative + chiller assist
description: Outside air never enters the room; it cools the room air through a heat exchanger; evaporative pre-cooling may run together with the chiller (hybrid).
source: A: ASHRAE TC 9.9 recommended envelope; eps_evap: ASHRAE Handbook ch. 41 (rigid media 70-95 %); eps_hx: ASHRAE Handbook ch. 41 (indirect 40-80 %), Park & Seo 2018; T_return: derived = A + 10 K server delta T (STULZ: 10-15 K), conservative lower bound

label: Indirect (heat exchanger) – evaporative or chiller, no combined mode
description: Outside air never enters the room; it cools the room air through a heat exchanger; when evaporative cooling alone is not enough, the chiller takes over completely.
source: A: ASHRAE TC 9.9 recommended envelope; eps_evap: ASHRAE Handbook ch. 41 (rigid media 70-95 %); eps_hx: ASHRAE Handbook ch. 41 (indirect 40-80 %), Park & Seo 2018; T_return: derived = A + 10 K server delta T (STULZ: 10-15 K), conservative lower bound
